findings.text: The D11 rename is only half done. condition-trace.png was renamed to jacobi-ratio-vs-constant-discriminator.png (R100) and the new name is cited, but its generator condition_discriminator_trace.py:51 still sets DEFAULT_FIGURE = OUTPUT_ROOT / "condition-trace.png" and is not in reviewed commit 6d99b59ba, so a re-run recreates the misnamed file the followup asked to retire. The followup's clause 'repoint anything that resolves through the old name' is unmet.

18 of the 41 retired files are still named by committed JSON receipts, so the artifact graph now names paths the served tree no longer carries. cross-revision/receipt.json carries vector_project_absolute_src for the deleted .svg twins (lines 108-109, 143-144); process-per-row/certificate.json and rows/*.json name the four deleted process-per-row panels; trip-quantum host-profile/profile.json, fallback-carry/outer-loop.json, late-trips/profile.json and recovery-frozen/outer-loop.json name deleted PNGs; frozen-partition-savings.json names the deleted frozen-partition PNG. Deleting from the served tree alone was the stated done-when, so this is a follow-on cleanup rather than a scope defect, but the receipts should be repointed or pruned.

The served landed record's prose still names the retired program-shape-buckets.svg ('An SVG twin (program-shape-buckets.svg) is written beside the PNG', with the regeneration narrative at lines 962 and 972 naming it as a figure artifact). The PNG twin survives and is cited, so no image is broken, but a reader following the prose to the named sibling SVG now finds no file.

gate_arms_note: The reviewed manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as null (not armed; the node changed no test file, only the suite-free renderer and docs). There are no readable pytest suite arms from which a failure delta can be computed, so added_failure_count 0 and added_failure_ids [] record no observed added suite failures rather than a completed suite delta. The node's own gates are readable: base-src-scan.log EXIT=1 (67/22/45, the negative control), head-src-scan.log EXIT=0 (26/26/0), and render-gate.log EXIT=0.

justifications.durability: Commit 6d99b59ba has a conventional subject and a substantive body, carries no attribution trailer, and the reviewed worktree is clean at that head; the fragment and the archive captions are committed in-repo so the citations survive as repository state. Deductions: at review time the head commit is local-only, not an ancestor of review base f8136784c, so integration is not yet landed; the headline report is outside the repository; and the retirement leaves committed receipts pointing at deleted served paths, which weakens the durability of the artifact graph it just tidied.
justifications.evidence: The load-bearing claim could fail and did not. I reran the identical src/href instrument independently: head 26/26/0, base 67/22/45 EXIT=1, both matching the reviewed logs exactly. I reproduced the receipt numbers the new captions rest on: reduced-newton/four-rows.json jacobian_builds_per_trip sums per row to 8, 6, 11, 3; adaptive-refresh/four-rows.json jacobian_builds_before {8,6,11,3} and _after {12,6,10,4}; program-census/1000.json 662331 against candidate/1000.json 204531 (69.12% reduction); width-one receipts' head_quantum_ms equal the render-gate values; both PNGs measure 1400x1200. The archive captions were read in place and each names its own receipt JSON path (reduced-newton/four-rows.json, adaptive-refresh/four-rows.json, program-size/cross-revision/receipt.json candidate_revision 42e6ade05). Deductions: the retirement scanned only served-doc citations, so 18 of the 41 retired files remain named by committed JSON receipts (cross-revision/receipt.json vector paths, process-per-row/certificate.json and rows/*.json, trip-quantum profile/outer-loop json, frozen-partition-savings.json) and the served archive's prose still names the retired program-shape-buckets.svg; a broad substring scan (67/27/40) also shows the head count is instrument-dependent, though the run used the stricter and correct src/href form.
justifications.fit: The repair is right-sized for the defect: delete what nothing cites, cite what survives from receipt-backed captions, re-render the one figure whose series was never plotted, and remove the one failed solve that could read as a converged result. Receipts are retained beside the survivors and the 41 retired files are recoverable from git history at base b12cb22cc, so nothing is lost. Small deductions: the receipt-reference cleanup was not carried through (vector paths, certificate/row JSONs), and the retained diverted-oracle-census-fine.png is itself a figure with an open null-vocabulary follow-on, so a fresh citation now points at contested content.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node's goal is the cite-or-retire followup for the millisecond-converged-solve figure cohort: every served PNG/SVG must either carry a project-absolute citation into an evidence record whose numbers re-derive from a committed receipt, or be deleted from the served tree, plus the five overlapping caption repairs (width-one HEAD bar, four-row split, cross-revision binding, one scope census, condition-trace rename) and removal of the failed-solve panel. Each clause was independently reproduced at reviewed head 6d99b59ba. My own src/href scan over docs/plans, docs/evidence, docs/research and docs/sprints returns FIGURES=26 CITED=26 UNCITED=0, and at base b12cb22cc returns FIGURES=67 CITED=22 UNCITED=45 with the SAME instrument, so the 45-to-0 contraction is real and the instrument demonstrably sees a known-present cohort. Every one of the 26 survivors traces to an evidence or research document (the landed archive, cpu-compile-abort-landed.html, single-evaluator-state-machine-design.html, compile-cost-evidence.html); none is cited only from the plan file. benchmarks/trip_quantum_width_one.py now draws the HEAD trip as a real fourth bar on a log baseline axis (names list 'HEAD trip', values include head_quantum_ms), both PNGs are 1400x1200, and the receipts give head_quantum_ms 72.14173589665052 and 2.7500823067612146. The failed diverted-single-null panel (terminal residual 2.092e-01) and its whole panels directory are gone. One clause is only half finished: the condition-trace rename repointed no generator, so DEFAULT_FIGURE still names the old file.
justifications.scope_discipline: The delta is confined to the granted paths: the figure directory (41 deletions, 2 re-renders, 1 rename), the cumulative landed archive, the new landing fragment, and the single renderer benchmarks/trip_quantum_width_one.py. No test file, solver source, tolerance, default or plan file changed; the plan was not edited and no sprint or index state was mutated; the detailed report sits outside the repository at its granted report path. Nothing out of scope and nothing omitted that the goal required, other than the generator repoint noted under goal_fidelity.
